content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking for CAD drawings (such as DWG, DXF, IGES, STP, etc.) for [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]) and [product_name] [product_name]. Does anyone have these drawings available? Thank you, [user_name]

I recently contacted [company_name] South Africa regarding the same request. It appears these files are not yet available. Information from [company_name] Germany suggests that they may be released early next year.

The CAD drawings are not currently available. However, the new [version_no] has the same dimensions as the previous [version_no] and looks similar. The [product_name] screen also shares its dimensions and appearance with an earlier screen version. More details can be found at: [url]
A new question posted in two forums has been moved to a separate thread titled Connect CATIA V5R6 to [product_name] [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for official CAD data for particular [company_name] products, aiming to obtain files like DWG, DXF, IGES, or STP for accurate engineering documentation. These files are currently unavailable or only older versions can be used as alternatives.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to have convenient access to accurate and current CAD files for the latest [product_name] hardware and operator devices to support precise design work.
